chunks: And whatever is in it from Minhal al-Qaṣṣāb, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Minhal al-Qaṣṣāb.

key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: al-ʿAṭṭār; part of the named transmitter Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; a transmission formula indicating the author's route of narration
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: from my father; the first link in the author’s stated chain
key_terms.عَنْ مِنْهَالِ الْقَصَّابِ: from Minhal al-Qaṣṣāb, identifying the source-narrator of this transmission line
key_terms.مَحْبُوبٍ: Maḥbūb; part of the named transmitter al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Minhal al-Qaṣṣāb in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Minhal al-Qaṣṣāb. It serves as a chain-identification notice in hadith transmission, preserving the provenance of the narration within the scholarly tradition.
